item.description: • A picture opens in a viewer of its own, sent, waiting in the composer or in the file viewer. Pinch, ⌘+ and ⌘− zoom it, ⌘0 fits it, a double click goes to its real pixels and back, and its menu shows it in Finder or opens it in Preview. • The plan's limits match what the agent's CLI reports. A newer reading no longer loses to an older one, the Fable week shows again, and a window whose reset has passed reads empty. • A reset your ChatGPT account already holds can be used from Codex's ↺ on the usage card, after a confirmation. Claude Code offers its `/limit-reset` only in its own terminal, so Claude has no button. • A thread a limit stopped goes on by itself when the limit starts over, the weekly one and Codex's monthly one too, and at once when a reset is used. • Each project on Everything Running folds, as it does in the drawer, and both stay folded together. • A subagent a thread runs shows under it on Everything Running while it works, and a click opens its transcript. • With two threads side by side, a click on the other one's text moves to it, as a click on empty glass does. Selecting text there still works. • A new thread opened from the drawer is laid out even when its last row never appeared, which could leave it blank until a scroll.
